overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Maine Board of Trustees was scheduled to hold a regular meeting to address multiple items including a $2,025,000 State Trust Fund Loan application, several zoning and ordinance amendments, infrastructure projects, and review of the 2027 proposed budget. The meeting was set to include reports from various departments and committees affecting village operations and future planning.

discussions.body: The board was scheduled to discuss and consider approving Resolution 2026-03 to authorize borrowing through the State Trust Fund Loan in the amount of $2,025,000. This action was expected to address significant capital funding needs for the village.

The board was set to discuss and take possible action on amendments to ordinance provisions governing accessory uses and structures within the village. This was expected to involve zoning regulation updates.

discussions.item: Ordinance §17.13-7(3)(c) Residential Districts Principal Building Lot Area
discussions.body: The board was scheduled to review and potentially act on amendments to regulations concerning principal building lot area requirements in residential districts. This action was expected to modify zoning standards for residential development.

discussions.item: Ordinance §17.13-8(3)(c) Multiple Family Residence District Principal Building Lot Area
discussions.body: The board was set to discuss and consider amendments to principal building lot area requirements for multiple family residence districts. This action was expected to adjust zoning regulations for multi-family housing development.

The board was scheduled to review and take possible action on amendments to ordinance provisions governing village board meeting procedures and conduct. This was expected to update meeting governance standards.
The board was set to discuss and consider action on village purchasing policy updates or revisions. This was expected to address procurement procedures and standards.

The board was scheduled to discuss and take possible action on road shouldering work for Timber Drive and North 20th Avenue. This was expected to address road infrastructure maintenance or improvements.

discussions.item: Falcon Drive and Lower Brokaw Housing RFP Preparation by REI
discussions.body: The board was set to discuss and consider action regarding request for proposal preparation by REI for housing development projects at Falcon Drive and Lower Brokaw. This was expected to advance housing development initiatives in the village.
The board was scheduled to discuss and take possible action on village hall rental policies or rates. This was expected to address facility use and revenue-related matters.
The board was set to review and consider action on quotes for village website design and redesign services. This was expected to address technology and communication infrastructure updates.
The board was scheduled to discuss and take possible action regarding the assessor contract. This was expected to address property assessment services for the village.
The board was set to discuss and consider action regarding the fall newsletter. This was expected to address village communications to residents.
The board was scheduled to discuss and take possible action on holiday lights at the village hall. This was expected to address seasonal decoration and community appearance matters.

The board was scheduled to review the proposed 2027 budget with a public hearing set for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. This was expected to allow for public input on the village's financial planning for the upcoming year.
The board was set to receive an update on TerX. This was expected to provide information on this ongoing matter or project.
